title: eSpring基金经理ChristinaWoon：印度市场估值回调，可作
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: So where you may be shifting to in place of career?
segments.zh: 那么你可能会转向哪些市场来替代韩国？

segments.en: Sure. I think outside of career, some other parts that are quite interesting would be within India. I think with the volatility in the tech trade at this point, India is starting to look interesting.
segments.zh: 当然。我认为除了韩国，印度市场也相当有趣。随着科技交易波动加剧，印度开始显得有吸引力。

segments.en: From a valuation perspective as well, that's come off a lot. It's quite a lagged. The other side of it is also with all prices coming off the attractiveness or I guess the relative healthiness of India as a market has improved as well.
segments.zh: 从估值角度看，印度市场已经大幅回调，相对滞后。另一方面，随着大宗商品价格回落，印度市场的吸引力或相对健康度也有所提升。

segments.en: That's where I would say some investors can look to for diversification as well as buffer amid the volatility within tech.
segments.zh: 我认为投资者可以关注印度市场，以实现分散配置，并在科技板块波动中提供缓冲。
